import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs/task-44dbc45f.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Tile the top-right panel across all panels, preserving divider lines."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((v for row in grid for v in row if all(x == v for x in row)), None)
    # The full-width horizontal divider identifies its color.
    divider = next(v for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1 for v in [row[0]])
    row_divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == divider for x in row)]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [0] + [r + 1 for r in row_divs]
    row_ends = row_divs + [h]
    col_bounds = [0] + [c + 1 for c in col_divs]
    col_ends = col_divs + [w]
    # Use upper-right panel as the pattern.
    top0, top1 = row_bounds[0], row_ends[0]
    left0, left1 = col_bounds[-1], col_ends[-1]
    source = [grid[r][left0:left1] for r in range(top0, top1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_bounds, row_ends):
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_bounds, col_ends):
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = source[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print(p,os.path.getsize(p))
